Stake $50 of the chain's native asset through Valantis stHYPE Restaking and hold the receipt token. Cost: $50 of capital and about $1 to $4 of gas per transaction. Time: 15 minutes to set up.
Do one qualifying action every week, such as a deposit, a borrow, a swap or a vote, so the wallet keeps showing up. Cost: about $1 to $4 of gas a week. Time: 10 minutes a week.
Leave the position alone for at least 60 days so the activity spans more than one snapshot. Cost: the $50 stays in the position. Time: 60 days.

Before you withdraw, open the protocol’s own points or rewards page and claim only from the link that page itself publishes. Cost: no fee to check, and never pay anyone to claim for you. Time: 10 minutes.
Write the wallet address, the dates and every transaction hash in a farm log, so you can repeat the position or unwind it later. Cost: nothing but the log. Time: 5 minutes.
